caption:
You send a message after work and need something by tomorrow.

A soft opener can make this worse, not better. If the work is truly needed soon, say that plainly and give a real fallback.

“I need this tomorrow, so I’m sending it now.”

What after-hours message do you dread sending most?

#newmanager #leadership #management

slides.label: After-hours ask
slides.headline: It’s late. You need something by tomorrow.
slides.sub: Your message sets the pressure level before they even reply.

slides.headline: Late message
rows: “I need this tomorrow, so I’m sending it now.”
“No rush, but can you get this to me first thing?”
“Please don’t feel like you need to reply tonight.”
“If not, send it by noon tomorrow.”

slides.headline: If it’s <u>urgent</u>, say it plainly and own the ask.
